answer.method_summary: All 100 supplied candidates were scored independently with the item-bound score_variant_fm tool. Prospective adaptive rule: because the declared endpoint is label-free Stability (ddG_ML_float; higher values preferred) and the available evidence is generic rather than assay-trained, convert ESM-IF1 mean log-likelihood and ESM-2 masked-marginal delta log-probability to descending empirical percentiles within the 100-candidate panel, then use a stability-gated composite of 0.70*IF1 percentile + 0.30*ESM2 percentile. Rank by composite descending; break exact ties by IF1 score descending, then ESM2 delta descending, then mutant lexically. Select ranks 1-10. Missing or failed evidence is a coverage failure and is never imputed as zero. These model scores measure generic sequence/backbone plausibility, not a measured ddG_ML_float outcome or a causal model of cDNA-display proteolysis, and may therefore be mechanistically misaligned.
